notes: dbdesigner.id = Vue 2 + Konva canvas ERD designer (frontend/) served by its Express+Sequelize+SQLite backend (backend/). setup.sh: mise (node 16.20.2, first line with arm64 builds that still runs Vue CLI 3/webpack 4), deps installed exactly from both package-lock.json files via .ui-capture/install-from-lock.js (curl-based; the sandbox proxy aborts npm/yarn packument fetches), native modules as listed in stubs, production build to frontend/dist. Only source change: backend/config/app.config.js port now honours PORT. start.sh runs `node backend/app.js` on PORT (4410), which serves the built UI at / and the API at /api/v1. Data: seed.js drives the app's own API (admin user add, login, project new/update/save/changeShareStatus) then back-dates timestamps in SQLite. Account Maya Hartono owns 25 projects created over ~13 months (marketplace v3 with 15 tables/20 relations, clinic records, LMS, kos rental, warehouse inventory, HRIS payroll, SaaS billing, fleet GPS, IoT, etc.; Indonesian & English naming, an old camelCase v2, a near-empty 'Untitled project', some blank descriptions); 10 are public (share link, viewers/likes), rest private. Two other users exist (dimas.prasetyo@gmail.com / dimas12345 owns one public design). Main areas: login panel (File menu, left drawer) -> Open project list (paginated, search) -> ERD canvas with tables/relations, table detail drawer (right), Properties, Account, Export (SQL/Laravel/Django/image/PDF), Share. Open a design directly: /?action=open&uuid=<id> after login; /?action=open-project shows the project list.
